entries.detail: The per-row Email control was present on all 6,414 rows, and every earlier proof counted it present. It rendered as bare text in the Links cell (0 of 6,414 styled as a button). In a browser with no suppression list loaded, the suppression block faded every one to 40% opacity, turned off its pointer, and relabelled it “Email — suppressed”. An instrument measuring presence reported a control the operator could not see as working.

entries.what: The visibility instrument measured its own scroll position
entries.detail: The first visibility census scrolled each row vertically only. Controls that sat beyond the viewport horizontally read invisible: 0 at 480 on every page, and every Chicago row at 1440. Each control is now scrolled into view on both axes, and a held control's pointer is restored for the hit test. The fixed instrument was tested on a known answer, three controls planted invisible on florida.html: it read 147 of 150. The first planted cover missed its target and had to be re-planted, so the test case was checked as well as the instrument.

“Email — suppressed” was shown both for an address on the suppression list and for every row when the list was merely unread. Held rows now read “Email — held: suppression list not loaded”; “Email — suppressed” appears only for an address on the list. The fail-closed hold itself is unchanged (Item 360).

entries.what: Function lost to a structural proof — class opened, nothing found this pass
entries.detail: Census of the composer at 83a861b, the last Florida composer before Items 370 and 371, against b0bb24b. Missing: none. Added: Open in Outlook web (drOW) and the postal Set link (drPS), both ruled in Item 371. Row tools: “First touch” removed because it bypassed the CAN-SPAM gate (Item 371, Phase 3, kept); “Replied” renamed “Reached” with the seven-stage set (ruled). Both the resource set and the three tones have been unchanged since 16 September.

(a) The composer header has read “Email <company>” since it was built; the panel has never carried decision maker, city, tier, status or market, so nothing was restored. (b) A tone change has always rewritten the body: ticked resources are kept and manual edits are replaced, so the brief’s request to preserve manual edits would change tone output and is refused under §3C. (c) The resource checkboxes are Who we are what we do, Health assessment, Website state page, Services and pricing, and Request a quote. The state Who We Are poster was never a composer checkbox; it travelled only in the removed First-touch link. Adding it would change body output, so it waits on a ruling.

Button styling, the button’s held and emailed-this-session states, Escape to close, and focus into To on open with return to the button on close. Copy confirmation already existed (“Copied ✓ paste into New mail”); its failure path was not exercised. Suppression was already wired: a listed address holds its row with the reason (proved on florida.html with sales@invictawatch.com listed as unsubscribed), and the composer gate refuses copy and open.

entries.what: Bing links counted as a site host
entries.detail: The suppression block’s domain check took the row’s first non-Google, non-LinkedIn link as the company’s site, so since Item 371 it could take a Bing search. Bing is now excluded the same way. No suppression outcome changed on the current data.
